description: This file implements a ReminderService module for a travel planning frontend. It manages reminders stored in localStorage, offers functions for CRUD operations, periodically checks for due reminders, and optionally dispatches browser notifications. It also allows subscription to reminder events.

methods.name: readStore()
methods.description: Reads reminders array from localStorage under key 'reminders'.

methods.name: writeStore(reminders)
methods.description: Writes reminders array to localStorage under key 'reminders'.

methods.name: readNotifiedIds()
methods.description: Reads array of notified reminder IDs from localStorage.

methods.name: writeNotifiedIds(ids)
methods.description: Stores array of notified reminder IDs to localStorage.

methods.name: ensureNotificationPermission()
methods.description: Requests notification permission if not already granted or denied.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic checking of reminders with setInterval.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Checks for due reminders, dispatches notifications, updates notified IDs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns sorted list of all reminders.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Creates or updates a reminder in localStorage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a reminder by ID from localStorage.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Allows external code to subscribe to reminder events.

methods.name: syncFromBackend
methods.description: Placeholder for syncing reminders from backend (not implemented).

methods.name: syncToBackend
methods.description: Placeholder for syncing a reminder to backend (not implemented).

ctags.name: LAST_NOTIFIED_KEY
ctags.pattern: /^const LAST_NOTIFIED_KEY = 'reminders_last_notified_ids'; \/\/ to avoid duplicate notifications a/
